description: Golden vectors of runtime_render (click_synth.py), the reference of the C++ impact renderer (audio.md 3.6). Frame: cloth plane z = 0, metres; the listener pressure p_pa[k] is at output sample k (48 kHz) for a contact starting at t_start_s. The C++ port must reproduce p_pa with residual energy <= -100 dB (AU-T11). force_frac_0.25 = runtime_force(frac=0.25) for debugging step 1. Kernels: ball_kernels_<ball>_48k.json; shape: hertz_shape_e095.json.
